verifiedChanges: One unified camera, drag-and-drop, multi-file, and folder intake surface
Repeated image selections append to one queue
Optional reported count uses a high abuse-protection ceiling rather than a product cap
Large detected sets use bounded serial identification with balanced mode and cooldown
Recognition retries are bounded and 429 capacity failures preserve reviewable unresolved records
Safe stop retains queued files and completed results without changing into a destructive clear control
Deterministic 36-record queue-integrity diagnostic is available through the normal SPA
Public scanner copy avoids provider-specific and internal-role wording
claimsBoundary: The provider returned overall E2E status passed while reporting total_jobs 9 and passed_jobs 8; both values are preserved exactly.
The 36-record diagnostic proves container preservation and grid regularization only, not real-image detector recall.
This release does not establish universal exact-card or exact-parallel accuracy.
This release is a hosted beta snapshot and is not proof of production PostgreSQL, private object storage, queues, backup restore, or canonical GitHub deployment equivalence.
Scheduled handler success does not prove model weights changed or recognition accuracy improved.
